relations.text: 年次報告で、ITサービス管理ツールのServiceNowなどとの連携を挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report cites integration with IT service management tools such as ServiceNow

source.label: Zscaler 10-K
source.quote: Automated workflows enable organizations to remediate these risks, integrating with mainstream IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow and Jira.

companies.name: Fortinet
companies.sub: ネットワークセキュリティ

relations.text: Fortinetの年次報告が、Zscalerを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Zscaler as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: Our competitors include companies such as Check Point, Cisco, CrowdStrike, F5 Networks, HPE, Huawei, Microsoft, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, SonicWALL, Sophos, and Zscaler.

companies.name: CrowdStrike
companies.sub: エンドポイントセキュリティ

relations.text: ZscalerのRed Canaryが、戦略パートナーのCrowdStrikeとの提携を拡大した
relations.text_en: Zscaler announced an expanded partnership between Red Canary, a Zscaler company, and strategic partner CrowdStrike

source.label: Zscaler の発表
source.quote: Zscaler, Inc. (NASDAQ: ZS), the leader in cloud security, today announced an expanded partnership between Red Canary, a Zscaler company, and strategic partner CrowdStrike to deliver enhanced protection across endpoints, users, and workloads.
source.note: Zscaler傘下のRed Canaryを通じた記載です。
source.note_en: Described via Zscaler's subsidiary Red Canary.

relations.text: ZscalerはGoogleのワークロード向けセキュリティやGoogle SecOps、Vertex AIとの連携を提供している
relations.text_en: Zscaler provides security for Google workloads, DLP for Workspace users, and integration with Google SecOps and the Vertex AI platform

source.label: Zscaler の発表
source.quote: Zscaler provides security for Google workloads, DLP for Workspace users, and integration with Google SecOps and the Vertex AI platform.

relations.text: ZscalerはNVIDIAとの協業を発表し、NVIDIAのAI技術をcopilotサービスに活用するとした
relations.text_en: Zscaler announced a collaboration with NVIDIA and said it will leverage NVIDIA AI technologies for its copilot services

source.label: Zscaler の発表
source.quote: Zscaler, Inc. (NASDAQ: ZS), a leader in cloud security, today announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to accelerate AI-powered copilot technologies. Zscaler will leverage NVIDIA AI technologies to deliver new user experience and security-centric copilot services to the enterprise.

relations.text: CoreWeaveは、Project AI-Guardianを通じてZscalerと連携すると述べている
relations.text_en: CoreWeave says it is working with Zscaler through Project AI-Guardian

source.label: Zscaler の発表
source.quote: working with Zscaler through Project AI-Guardian means customers will be able to enforce zero trust access controls at every layer of their AI stack, from compute to agent interaction.

relations.text: Equinixは、Zscalerとの長年の提携をAIの保護に生かすと述べている
relations.text_en: Equinix describes its longstanding partnership with Zscaler, combining global digital infrastructure with zero trust security

source.label: Zscaler の発表
source.quote: Our longstanding partnership with Zscaler makes that vision even more powerful, by combining global digital infrastructure with zero trust security to help customers protect their AI interactions.

relations.text: OpenAIは、Zscalerとの提携とProject AI-Guardianを通じてAIの責任ある活用を進めると述べている
relations.text_en: OpenAI cites its partnership with Zscaler and Project AI-Guardian in advancing responsible AI deployment

source.label: Zscaler の発表
source.quote: Through our partnership with Zscaler and initiatives like Trusted Access for Cyber and Project AI-Guardian, we're advancing a shared commitment to deploying AI responsibly

relations.text: NTT DATAは、Project AI GuardianでZscalerと協業していると述べている
relations.text_en: NTT DATA says it is collaborating with Zscaler on Project AI Guardian

source.label: Zscaler の発表
source.quote: By collaborating with Zscaler on Project AI Guardian, NTT DATA is combining Zscaler's Zero Trust Everywhere framework with our full-stack Security for AI capabilities to help enterprises prepare for frontier AI risks
source.note: 子会社NTT DATAによる記載です。
